backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the RBS backend, defining all data types (UserProfile, Poll, Alert, MarketIntelligence, etc.) and initializing state maps for users, submissions, polls, API keys, and more, with authorization and blob storage mixins included.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that mirrors all backend data types and defines the OldActor shape to support state migration across canister upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no recorded features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key implementation details of each component, page, hook, and config file.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom property design tokens for light and dark themes including colors, borders, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the RBS frontend app, mounting the React root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/NO_VISUAL_CHANGES_ALERTS_BACKEN: Documentation file describing a backend-only alerts system implementation, listing added backend methods and corresponding React Query hooks without any frontend visual changes.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application file that configures TanStack Router with all page routes, wraps the app in QueryClient and ThemeProvider, and renders the shared RootLayout with Header, Footer, BottomNav, and AuthInitializer.
frontend/src/components/AdminApiKeysPane: React component that displays and manages API key configuration for external data providers (CoinGecko, CryptoCompare, etc.), allowing admins to view key status and update keys via a form.
Non-visual component that triggers backend initialization once after authentication, handles identity changes, and invalidates React Query caches to load fresh data.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar for mobile (hidden on lg screens) with links to main app routes, highlighting the active route.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer displaying the RBS brand, Telegram and WhatsApp social links, copyright, and a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed top navigation header with logo, primary nav links, dropdown menus for Resources/Community/Analytics sections, and a login/logout button using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/PageHead.tsx: Utility component that imperatively sets the document title and meta description tag based on provided props.
frontend/src/components/ScrollToTop.tsx: Component that auto-scrolls to the top on route changes and renders a floating button to manually scroll to top when the user has scrolled past 500px.
frontend/src/components/SmokySectionTran: Wrapper component that uses IntersectionObserver to apply a smoky reveal CSS animation when a section enters the viewport, with reduced-motion support.
frontend/src/constants/redirectConfig.ts: Defines redirect URLs and contact info for WhatsApp, Telegram, and Binance Square, plus a helper function to return a mobile deep link or web URL for Binance Square.
frontend/src/constants/socialLinks.ts: Re-exports a flat SOCIAL_LINKS object derived from REDIRECT_CONFIG for convenient access to social platform URLs throughout the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminConfig.ts: Provides React Query hooks for checking admin status, fetching API key statuses (currently mocked), and setting API keys via mutations.
Thin wrapper hook that exposes market intelligence access status by delegating to the `useHasMarketIntelAccess` query.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommunityVoting.ts: Aggregates poll-related queries and mutations into a single hook, exposing poll data, create/vote actions, and cache invalidation helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountdownTimer.ts: Fetches a presale or airdrop timer end time from the backend actor and drives a live countdown with per-second interval updates, falling back to hardcoded timestamps on error.
frontend/src/hooks/useCryptoNews.ts: Fetches and normalizes the latest crypto news items from the CryptoPanic public API, deriving sentiment from vote counts and caching results for 12 hours.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context provider and hook, managing AuthClient lifecycle, login/logout flow, and identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useLivePrice.ts: Polls the CoinGecko simple price API every 7 seconds to return live price, 24h change, market cap, and volume for a fixed set of top cryptocurrencies.
frontend/src/hooks/useMarketIntelLive.ts: Fetches OHLC and price data from CoinGecko for multiple coins and computes RSI, MACD, and MA-crossover-based BUY/SELL/HOLD signals with confidence scores.
frontend/src/hooks/useMarketPulse.ts: Fetches 30-day Bitcoin price history and current price from CoinGecko, computes RSI and MACD indicators, and returns an overall Bullish/Bearish/Neutral market status refreshed every 20 seconds.
frontend/src/hooks/useParallax.ts: Provides two hooks: `useParallax` for scroll-based vertical offset and `usePointerParallax` for pointer-movement-based 2D offset, both respecting the `prefers-reduced-motion` media query.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes React Query hooks for backend actor calls, covering user profile CRUD, market intel access, and alert management (fetch, create, mark-read, delete).
frontend/src/hooks/useRealWorldAnalytics: Fetches global crypto market data from the CoinGecko API every 60 seconds and exposes it as a typed `GlobalMarketData` object, along with a `formatLargeNumber` utility.
frontend/src/hooks/useReliableAuth.ts: Wraps Internet Identity login/logout with race-condition prevention, a 30-second safety timeout, and automatic retry on 'already authenticated' errors, invalidating React Query cache on state changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useTokenAdvancedAnaly: Fetches 30-day price/volume data for a given token from CoinGecko and computes technical indicators (RSI, Bollinger Bands, volatility, volume trend, market strength) returning a typed `TokenAnalytics` object.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Inter/Poppins fonts, configures Tailwind with CSS custom properties for a gold-and-white theme, and defines ambient background animations with reduced-motion support.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped in `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider`.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Static about page for RBS that presents the company mission and a grid of six feature cards (security, speed, community, etc.) with parallax and smoky transition animations.
frontend/src/pages/AcquisitionPage.tsx: Token acquisition page with tabbed presale and airdrop registration forms, countdown timers that unlock submission, and WhatsApp redirect for form delivery with session-storage persistence for pending submissions.
frontend/src/pages/AdultFormPage.tsx: Age-verification form that collects personal details, validates the user is 18+, and opens WhatsApp with the prefilled submission data using the `openWhatsApp` utility.
frontend/src/pages/AdvancedAnalyticsPage: Token analytics page with a symbol search input that fetches advanced metrics (Bollinger Bands, RSI, MACD, volume trend, risk level) via `useTokenAdvancedAnalytics` and renders them in a responsive card grid.
frontend/src/pages/AISentimentPage.tsx: Displays a list of crypto news articles fetched via the `useCryptoNews` hook, each tagged with a sentiment label (positive/negative/neutral) and a relative timestamp. Includes a 12-hour cache countdown timer and loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/AlertsCenterPage.tsx: A page for authenticated users to manage on-chain persistent alerts, supporting creating, reading, marking as read, deleting, and toggling alert triggers via React Query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityGovernancePa: A static informational page describing RBS community governance features including the proposal system, voting power mechanics, and governance timeline.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityHighlightsPa: A static page showcasing community achievements, featured members, initiatives, and stats for the RBS ecosystem.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityVotingPage.t: An interactive community polling page allowing authenticated users to join polls by code, cast votes, and create new polls (gated by a passcode) using the useCommunityVoting hook.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: A contact page with a form that opens the user's email client via a mailto link, plus direct channel links to Telegram and WhatsApp.
frontend/src/pages/DeveloperBlogPage.tsx: A placeholder developer blog page component with imports for card UI, badges, and layout components but no implemented content.
frontend/src/pages/DeveloperToolsPage.ts: A placeholder developer tools page component with imports for card UI, buttons, and icons but no implemented content.
frontend/src/pages/EcosystemGrowthPage.t: Displays the RBS ecosystem growth strategies page with four cards covering Community Expansion, Market Penetration, Product Development, and Value Creation, each showing key metrics. Uses parallax scrolling and smoky section transitions for visual effects.
frontend/src/pages/FAQPage.tsx: Renders a collapsible FAQ page with ten questions and answers covering RBS token details, governance, tokenomics, launch timeline, presale/airdrop participation, and security. Uses a stateful accordion pattern to toggle individual FAQ items open or closed.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: The main landing page featuring a hero section with the RBS logo and call-to-action buttons linking to the acquisition and whitepaper pages, followed by a platform features grid showcasing six capability cards. Uses SmokySectionTransition for animated section reveals.
frontend/src/pages/IndicatorsGuidePage.t: An educational page explaining technical trading indicators (RSI, MACD, and others) using an accordion layout where each indicator expands to show definition, settings, and interpretation examples. Styled with gold-themed glass cards and icon headers.
frontend/src/pages/InsightsPage.tsx: Displays real-time global crypto market analytics (total market cap, BTC dominance, active cryptocurrencies, etc.) fetched via the useRealWorldAnalytics hook, auto-refreshing every minute. Shows loading skeletons on initial load and error messaging on fetch failure.
frontend/src/pages/LivePricePage.tsx: Displays real-time prices for the top 5 cryptocurrencies, refreshing every 7 seconds, with authentication guard using Internet Identity. Shows price, market cap, and 24h change with loading skeletons and error states.
frontend/src/pages/MarketIntelPage.tsx: Passcode-gated page showing live trading signals and market intelligence, requiring both Internet Identity login and a valid passcode to unlock. Handles access checking, passcode submission, and live signal display with auto-refresh.
frontend/src/pages/MarketPulsePage.tsx: Shows real-time Bitcoin market sentiment (Bullish/Bearish/Neutral) with RSI, MACD, price, and 24h change indicators, refreshing every 20 seconds. No authentication guard; renders loading skeletons and error states.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: 404 error page with navigation buttons to go home or go back, plus quick-links to key site sections like Tokenomics, Roadmap, Whitepaper, and Contact.
frontend/src/pages/PartnersPage.tsx: Static page listing RBS ecosystem partners grouped into Strategic, Technology, and Community categories, each displayed as cards with partner names and roles.
frontend/src/pages/RoadmapPage.tsx: Displays the RBS development roadmap as a vertical timeline with five phases from 2026 to 2028, each showing status (completed/in-progress/upcoming) and milestone bullets with parallax scrolling effect.
frontend/src/pages/SecurityTransparencyP: Displays a security and transparency page for RBS with four feature cards (audits, multi-sig, transparency, reports) using parallax and smoky transition animations.
frontend/src/pages/TestimonialsPage.tsx: Renders a testimonials page with a carousel of six community member quotes and a stats grid showing community size, token holders, security score, and satisfaction rate.
frontend/src/pages/TokenomicsPage.tsx: Shows RBS token distribution via a Recharts pie chart and lists utility features (staking, governance, fees, premium tools) with parallax and smoky section transitions.
frontend/src/pages/WhitepaperPage.tsx: Renders a multi-chapter whitepaper page with a sticky sidebar navigation that highlights the active chapter using IntersectionObserver and supports smooth scroll-to-chapter.
frontend/src/utils/timers.ts: Exports a single utility function that converts a nanosecond bigint into a zero-padded days/hours/minutes/seconds display object.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities to read URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, persist them in sessionStorage, and remove sensitive params from the URL hash without reloading.
frontend/src/utils/whatsapp.ts: Exports helpers to build, open, or redirect to a WhatsApp URL pre-filled with a formatted message using the configured direct number from REDIRECT_CONFIG.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom color tokens using oklch/hsl CSS variables (including gold, silver, sidebar, chart colors), custom shadows, border radii, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state document (version 3) describing a multi-section app with pending feature requests for Market Intel passcode unlock, Pre-Sale/Airdrop countdown timers, live trading signals via CoinGecko, and full UI/functionality completion across all sections.
